desc: 暖玫瑰陶土色块详情页，缎白瓶多效香波，十一镜从痛点到收口
leaf: 犬猫通用多效合一沐浴香波（无标签缎白磨砂瓶配银色竖纹滚花旋盖）
name: 犬猫多效合一沐浴香波款

shots.intent: 首屏用暖玫瑰与陶土色块加香槟金道具把无标签缎白瓶拍成有质感的洗护主角，一秒建立犬猫沐浴香波的品类认知并拿下停留。
shots.textZone: 右上两行主标题带，其下一枚胶囊标签位与一行英文小字位

shots.intent: 把三条核心接受度理由压成一排同构细线图标加一行主标题，替掉源图与洗护无关的设备类图标，让买家一秒读完为什么选它。
shots.textZone: 顶部两行主标题带与一行英文小字位，三枚图标正下方各一行短标签位，下角色带内一行短句位

shots.intent: 用四格可代人的日常洗护现象加中央陶土实心圆盘把摩擦聚成一个焦点，把留香之外的护理需求讲成买家自己的经历。
shots.textZone: 顶部两行主标题带，四卡左上角各一枚深砖红胶囊标签位，中央圆盘内一行短语位

shots.intent: 用一枚居中正侧影瓶身加五枚实心陶土圆盘虚线环绕，把五条选择理由结构化成可扫读的机理屏，替掉源图与洗护无关的面料词。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与一枚陶土胶囊副标位，五枚圆盘外侧各一行引线短标签位

shots.intent: 同机位同光两栏毛发状态对照，把洗护结果拍成看得见的差值，替买家完成值不值这一步判断。
shots.textZone: 两栏顶部各一枚深砖红胶囊状态标签位，顶部居中主标题带

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实的家庭洗澡动线，让养宠人代入自己在浴室给宠物洗一次澡的时刻，从信息屏切回生活屏。
shots.textZone: 左上主标题带与一行短句位，其下一枚陶土胶囊标签位

shots.intent: 微距交代银色竖纹旋盖的滚花、瓶颈两圈刻线与缎白瓶肩过渡，用可见做工替代口头密封承诺。
用三格左右交错的陶土与玫瑰色块视窗交代盖体、瓶肩与瓶底三段真实结构，把源图重复四次的无关模板文案换成可信细节证据。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与一行短句位，三格旁各一行英文小字加一行小标题加一行短句位

shots.intent: 用四格等尺寸流程把打湿、涂抹、冲洗、擦干四步讲成一次可完成的洗澡，把决策成本降到零并交代用量方式。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与一行短句位，四格步序圆片下方各一行步骤小标题位

shots.intent: 用干净的双栏信息卡一次答完名称、适用对象与使用方式，把源图那块会员贴片与二维码换成中性可读的字段表。
shots.textZone: 顶部色带主标题位，左栏六行字段标签配占位值，右栏照片卡与一枚胶囊角标位

shots.intent: 收口回到首屏同源的陶土与玫瑰色块，用仰视气势把一瓶香波拍成洗澡这件事的定心答案，给一个低摩擦下单动作。
shots.textZone: 上半区两行主标题带与一行副标题位，右下一枚圆角胶囊按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: two linked systems held to one language: warm colour-block studio screens where a blush pink field #F0B4B6 meets one deeper clay rose wall panel #A85C54 with one champagne gold wire grid #C9A15B at the side, used for the opening, bathing-scene and closing screens, and flat clean #FFFFFF infographic screens carrying solid clay rose discs and wells #A85C54, one dashed hairline orbit ring in #A85C54, rounded cards with 20px corner radius and deep brick capsule pills #B04A42, used for every mid-page screen; never a third background language and never a cool or clinical tint
style.direction: warm editorial colour-block pet grooming commerce
style.iconSystem: single-family thin-line glyphs drawn in #A85C54 at one stroke weight with one short clay underline dash beneath each caption, solid clay disc tokens #A85C54 carrying #FFFFFF captions, deep brick capsule pills #B04A42 with #FFFFFF text, plain solid round step chips #A85C54 with #FFFFFF digits, and one recurring short double-dash rule in #FFFFFF or #A85C54 as the section divider; no droplets with faces, no cartoon paw characters, no medical crosses, no organ diagrams, no seals, medals, ribbons or shield badges

the upright satin-white bottle with its domed shoulder and vertically knurled silver screw collar held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and the same scale on every screen, matte satin finish, shoulder radius, collar knurling and two engraved neck rings true to the reference, only one bottle unit with no pump head, carton or invented second size, the label plane kept clean and unprinted with no added lettering, cats and dogs always cropped or turned away so no individual animal reads as identifiable; noDrift: no cool blue or clinical mint screens
no pump head, trigger sprayer, carton, blister or second bottle size
no printed characters, brand marks or invented label artwork on the bottle body or cap
no QR codes, membership stickers, contact blocks or store badges
no white coats, stethoscopes or veterinary costumes on any animal
no medical crosses, skin-lesion illustrations, organ or flea diagrams
no fabricated certifications, inspection seals, medals, ribbons, awards or sales figures

style.presentationRules: the upright satin-white bottle with its domed shoulder and its vertically knurled silver screw collar is held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and the same scale on every screen, grounded by a soft contact shadow, its matte satin finish, shoulder radius, collar knurling and two engraved neck rings true to the reference and never restyled; only one bottle unit exists so no second size, pump head, carton or dispenser is ever introduced; the label plane is kept clean and unprinted as in the reference and no lettering is ever added to the body; cats and dogs are always cropped or turned away so no individual animal reads as identifiable; card corners fixed at 20px
style.surfaceSystem: matte lacquered podium cylinders and low plinth blocks in blush pink #F0B4B6, one matte pale tile ledge #EDEDEA in the single scene screen, matte white counter #FFFFFF on every infographic screen, and two or three champagne gold spheres #C9A15B as the only loose props; no mirror reflection, no wet gloss on the studio podiums
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif Chinese with one headline weight per screen; headlines in #FFFFFF on clay fields and in #3E3A38 on blush and white fields, one thin spaced English kicker line in #B04A42 or #FFFFFF above each headline, capsule tag pills with #FFFFFF text on #A85C54 or #B04A42 at 16-20pt, band captions and icon labels at 14-20pt, spec-row labels at 16pt; every rendered line is carried as a placeholder, never as source copy
